scope: Selected public sources. No intake attachments or private source paths. Review depth is distinct from experimental evidence.

entries.title: Multi-resonant THz modulation with thin-film lithium niobate
entries.possible_insight: TFLN with three QBIC resonances converts small optical-pump perturbations into THz transmission changes.
entries.scope_limit: Reported maximum modulation is about 0.8% under 532 nm CW pumping; future electrical tuning is not the demonstrated result.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: 600 nm x-cut LN film and patterned resonator supercell; retrieve lateral dimensions and tolerance budget.
entries.next_action: Read methods and quantify required pump, response speed, losses and drift before modeling a module.
entries.decision: candidate; no architecture adoption

entries.title: Sub-Micron Resolution, Large-Scale Magnetic Printing of Orthorhombic Photonic Crystals
entries.possible_insight: Magnetic alignment at a drying front assembles photonic structures from nanorods; candidate bottom-up upgrade process.
entries.scope_limit: The 750 nm minimum reported domain width uses lithographically patterned channels and a 0.3 T field; it is not arbitrary 750 nm placement.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Fe3O4@SiO2 nanorod ink, drying and template confinement; qualify material synthesis, template, defects and optical response.
entries.next_action: Extract process from methods/SI; compare externally seeded templates with machine-made fixtures and automated drying/field control.
entries.decision: candidate; no architecture adoption

entries.title: Terahertz generation from chirped and delayed laser pulses in a periodically poled lithium niobate waveguide
entries.possible_insight: Optically pumped waveguide source demonstrates generation around 488 GHz; precedent for a compact conversion module.
entries.scope_limit: Source generation is distinct from spatial-mode selection and arbitrary field control.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: 500 × 500 µm waveguide cross-section; include poling, ultrafast pump, coupling and detection in effort budget.
entries.next_action: Reproduce frequency/phase-matching calculation; quantify full-system efficiency and effort only for a named sensing need.
entries.decision: candidate; no architecture adoption

entries.title: Atomic lithography of two dimensional nanostructures
entries.possible_insight: SLM interference fields steer an incoming atomic beam onto substrate locations electronically.
entries.scope_limit: Example region about 3 × 3 µm; serial writing and multi-spot crosstalk discussed. Patent is not evidence of a built general printer.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Atomic beam, suitable laser/SLM and vacuum substrate process; surface growth and throughput require separate models.
entries.next_action: Reproduce a source example and compare captured mass rate, area and feature quality against conventional deposition.
entries.decision: candidate; no architecture adoption

entries.title: Pattern formation method and apparatus using atomic beam holography technology
entries.possible_insight: Holographic diffraction/reflection of a coherent atomic matter wave.
entries.scope_limit: Not optical-force steering of a thermal atom beam; patent example uses about 50 µK atoms.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Coherent atomic source and atomic hologram/reflection interfaces; manufacturing and coherence budgets unresolved.
entries.next_action: Assess source/coherence burden before considering integration; keep separate from dipole-force trajectory model.
entries.decision: candidate; no architecture adoption

entries.title: Particle beam device
entries.possible_insight: Periodic static fields acting on a moving beam offer a beam-state-conditioning analogy.
entries.scope_limit: Purpose is generating radiation from high-energy particles, not deposition; no manufacturing capability established.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Accelerator and evacuated interaction structure; not a P0 seed component.
entries.next_action: Retain as background; require a specific lower-energy manufacturing benefit before further work.
entries.decision: candidate; no architecture adoption

entries.title: Laser Focused Atomic Deposition
entries.possible_insight: Laser standing waves focus chromium during deposition on silicon.
entries.scope_limit: Reported lines 65 nm wide, 34 nm high over 0.4 mm × 1 mm in about ten minutes; not arbitrary 3D fabrication.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Atomic beam, laser and substrate-growth process; distinguish incident focus from deposited profile.
entries.next_action: Use as a benchmark for optical-force/deposition calculations, with process parameters from full paper.
entries.decision: candidate; no architecture adoption

entries.title: Direct printing of metasurfaces using formulated optical materials
entries.possible_insight: TiO2 nanoparticle-resin replication is a candidate bridge from a purchased seed master to working optical plates.
entries.scope_limit: Replication still needs master/molds, material preparation and qualification; not an active transducer demonstration.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: High-index resin and nanoimprint process; establish shrinkage, defects, optical loss and geometry sensitivity.
entries.next_action: Extract complete recipe/access requirements and compare outsourced master plus replication against direct fabrication.
entries.decision: candidate; no architecture adoption

entries.title: Holograms for acoustics
entries.possible_insight: Printed polymer phase plates shape an incident acoustic field; candidate passive replacement for some control hardware.
entries.scope_limit: A fixed transform does not supply arbitrary dynamic control; medium and task must match the precedent.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Printed polymer hologram; derive phase-height, loss and registration tolerance for our medium.
entries.next_action: Compare passive insert with direct drive on the same task, power and field-quality criteria.
entries.decision: candidate; no architecture adoption

entries.title: Two-Dimensional Manipulation in Mid-Air Using a Single Transducer Acoustic Levitator
entries.possible_insight: Vibrating plate plus reflector uses frequency switching to move a levitated cluster along predefined 2D trajectories.
entries.scope_limit: Demonstrates restricted trajectories, not arbitrary 3D multi-trap fields or our six-actuator geometry.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Piezo stack bonded to a 50 mm square silicon plate; reflector alignment and temperature matter.
entries.next_action: Extract coupled response and switching dynamics; benchmark the minimal-drive model on a comparable task.
entries.decision: candidate; no architecture adoption

entries.title: Systematic Design and Experimental Demonstration of Transmission-Type Multiplexed Acoustic Metaholograms
entries.possible_insight: Passive unit cells encode different acoustic patterns at different frequencies.
entries.scope_limit: Frequency-selected predefined patterns do not establish arbitrary per-pixel programmability or stable particle handling.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Two Fabry–Perot channels per cell; obtain dimensions, loss and bandwidth before scaling.
entries.next_action: Compare frequency-dependent passive aperture patterns with the pressure and force patterns required by AC-03.
entries.decision: candidate; no architecture adoption

entries.title: Power Ultrasonic Transducers — Langevin transducer brochure
entries.possible_insight: Power piezo source option with application-specific design and drive electronics.
entries.scope_limit: Mechanical quality factor is not the mounted plate bandwidth; electrical update rate does not establish acoustic modulation bandwidth.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Piezo rings, preload and mechanical assembly must be modeled with the attached plate and radiative loading.
entries.next_action: Select a concrete source model and calculate loaded frequency response, force, thermal load and ring-down before choosing Langevin.
entries.decision: candidate; no architecture adoption

entries.title: Langevin Transducers Incorporating TPMS Lattice Front Masses
entries.evidence_status: conference abstract reports fabricated and characterized devices
entries.possible_insight: Powder-bed-fused lattice front masses co-designed with Langevin stacks; modal FEA checked using impedance and vibrometry.
entries.scope_limit: Around-20-kHz power-transducer work; not arbitrary multiport airborne trapping. Conference abstract is not a full methods audit.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: TPMS front masses; micro-CT examines structure and excitation-associated cracks. Process and fatigue qualification matter.
entries.next_action: Obtain full methods, material/process details and measured response before using as a quantitative benchmark.
entries.decision: candidate; no architecture adoption

entries.title: Parametric Study of Bolt Clamping Effect on Resonance Characteristics of Langevin Transducers with Lumped Circuit Models
entries.possible_insight: Preload and masses influence impedance and resonance; use a coupled transducer model for a replacement printed body.
entries.scope_limit: Source-specific geometry and torque; do not transfer its preload values directly to another stack.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Preloaded piezoceramic rings, front/rear masses and bolt; contact faces and load path are functional components.
entries.next_action: Use modeling approach to bound preload/contact sensitivity of the chosen cartridge or custom front-mass assembly.
entries.decision: candidate; no architecture adoption

entries.title: Holographic acoustic elements for manipulation of levitated objects
entries.authors: Marzo, Seah, Drinkwater, Sahoo, Long, Subramanian
entries.possible_insight: Drive optimisation on the Gor'kov potential: maximise its Laplacian and minimise pressure at the target. Same force model as the twin; the AC-03a inner problem constrains rest position and the weakest trap frequency instead.
entries.scope_limit: Phased arrays of 10 mm 40 kHz transmitters at 16 V p-p moving 0.6–3.1 mm polystyrene; many independent channels, not few strong ports.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Catalog 40 kHz transmitters; no made acoustic part.
entries.next_action: Benchmark the inner solver against a published trap shape if a case with full geometry is found.
entries.decision: reference for the AC-03a reduced model; no architecture adoption

entries.title: Observer Patch Holography: programme, basis and formal library
entries.possible_insight: Interfaces, shared records and geometry suggest compact module representations and feedback.
entries.scope_limit: The upstream programme states that full agreement with observed measurement statistics is not established; formal results retain their premises.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: No component recipe follows solely from a formal carrier or port count.
entries.next_action: Attach any proposed physical mechanism to a specific response model, observable and independent comparison.
entries.decision: reference for physics handbook; no hardware capability promotion

entries.title: NIST Atomic Spectra Database
entries.possible_insight: Element and ion spectra provide quantitative identification and interaction data.
entries.scope_limit: A spectrum is a set of transitions; it is not a universal audible note or a manufacturing recipe.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Specify species, ionization state, transition, environment and instrument.
entries.next_action: Select transitions and coupling data for a named sensing or optical process.
entries.decision: reference for physics handbook; no hardware capability promotion

entries.title: Atomic Spectroscopy — Spectral Lines
entries.possible_insight: Transition probabilities and selection rules explain why frequency matching alone is insufficient.
entries.scope_limit: Atomic transition models do not describe the elastic response of a macroscopic component.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Use the physical state and interaction appropriate to the process.
entries.next_action: Include coupling strength and linewidth with every proposed spectral control.
entries.decision: reference for physics handbook; no hardware capability promotion

entries.title: The Universal One
entries.possible_insight: A unified picture of form and organized motion motivates questions about geometry and stable patterns.
entries.scope_limit: Russell uses light in a metaphysical sense; the book does not validate element-to-tone machine settings.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: No fabrication specification inferred from the historical chart.
entries.next_action: Translate a proposed correspondence into a quantitative observable before using it as a design input.
entries.decision: reference for physics handbook; no hardware capability promotion

entries.title: Kilogram: Mass and Planck’s Constant
entries.identifier: NIST SI redefinition: mass and Planck constant
entries.possible_insight: Clarifies the relations between photon energy, frequency and rest energy.
entries.scope_limit: An energy-equivalent frequency is not automatically a material resonance.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: A usable process still requires a coupling, bandwidth and energy budget.
entries.next_action: Use frequency conversions only for explicitly identified physical quantities.
entries.decision: reference for physics handbook; no hardware capability promotion

entries.title: The Standard Model
entries.possible_insight: Distinguishes electromagnetic radiation from ordinary matter particles in the physical model.
entries.scope_limit: The overview does not validate a common-substrate ontology or a Replicator process.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: No fabrication route is specified by this classification.
entries.next_action: Retain the relevant interaction physics when translating unifying ideas into module models.
entries.decision: reference for physics handbook; no hardware capability promotion

entries.title: Compact holographic sound fields enable rapid one-step assembly of matter in 3D
entries.possible_insight: Multiple acoustic holograms arrange particles into three-dimensional structures, with fixation routes.
entries.scope_limit: Reported material and apparatus scope applies; particle assembly is distinct from atomic crystal growth.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Hologram geometry, acoustic medium, feedstock and consolidation require qualification.
entries.next_action: Compare a reported assembly case with the intended feed and first useful part.
entries.decision: reference for physics handbook; no hardware capability promotion

entries.title: OPH compact response-algebra selection
entries.possible_insight: The complete-response and inner-transport premises constrain the twelve-dimensional algebra to u(1) plus su(3) plus su(2).
entries.scope_limit: This selects an algebra under explicit premises; it does not alone supply physical currents, couplings or atomic interactions.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: No transducer count or fabrication tolerance follows from the formal carrier.
entries.next_action: Retain each response premise and physical identification when using the construction.
entries.decision: reference construction and engineering model; no hardware capability promotion

entries.title: OPH finite Gauss atom: volume and spacing refinement
entries.possible_insight: A Green potential derived from an incidence operator yields a definite bound-state Hamiltonian and an atomic refinement comparison.
entries.scope_limit: Mass, coupling, charge, kinetic law and boundaries are supplied. Successive-grid changes do not certify continuum error or physical hydrogen agreement.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Atomic-model calculation, not a fabrication process.
entries.next_action: Extend the same specified model with many-electron interactions and compare identified observables.
entries.decision: reference construction and engineering model; no hardware capability promotion

entries.title: n + l Filling Rule in the Periodic System and Focusing Potentials
entries.possible_insight: A focusing potential produces n+l threshold degeneracy and connects radial screening to nominal filling order.
entries.scope_limit: Threshold structure is distinct from a complete many-electron ground-state calculation; the handbook uses twice the original parameter μ.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: No manufacturing process is established by orbital counting.
entries.next_action: Use explicitly defined threshold scores and retain known model scope when comparing spectra.
entries.decision: reference construction and engineering model; no hardware capability promotion

entries.title: Internal Symmetry of the Maxwell Fish-Eye Problem and the Fock Group for the Hydrogen Atom
entries.possible_insight: The wave problem relates spherical harmonics, hidden Coulomb symmetry and n-squared degeneracy.
entries.scope_limit: The coordinate/operator correspondence does not identify an arbitrary finite lattice with a physical atom.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Potential profiles and optical/acoustic analogues require their own material implementation.
entries.next_action: Keep geometry, operator and energy/coupling parameter distinct in inverse design.
entries.decision: reference construction and engineering model; no hardware capability promotion

entries.title: Quantum ESPRESSO PHonon: force constants and vibrational modes
entries.possible_insight: Force-constant and dynamical matrices connect an electronic-structure calculation to vibrational response.
entries.scope_limit: Predictions depend on the chosen electronic model, structure and numerical convergence; a phonon model does not specify a growth process.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Requires composition, crystal structure and a qualified constitutive model.
entries.next_action: Use validated material response in coupled body design and compare with reusable metrology.
entries.decision: reference construction and engineering model; no hardware capability promotion

entries.title: 3D Printing Macroscale Engineered Materials Using Ultrasound Directed Self-Assembly and Stereolithography
entries.possible_insight: Ultrasound arranges particles in resin; patterned exposure fixes successive layers into composites with designed microstructure, including conductive fiber patterns.
entries.scope_limit: Layered resin process, not arbitrary volumetric atomic assembly or a demonstration of combined acoustic, magnetic and optical control.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Reported examples use nickel-coated carbon fibers and 0.45 mm half-wavelength line spacing; streaming and squeeze flow can disturb alignment.
entries.next_action: Evaluate a compatible feedstock and reusable cartridge against the first self-made part, including optical access and cure effects.
entries.decision: Process precedent; candidate integration study

entries.title: Development and Characterization of Field Structured Magnetic Composites
entries.possible_insight: Magnetic particle alignment is integrated with material jetting, UV curing and thermal post-curing to create anisotropic composites.
entries.scope_limit: Material-specific magnetic/polymer process; acoustic integration and our candidate three-field recipe are not demonstrated.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Ferromagnetic fillers in a dual-cure resin; alignment, optical attenuation and final cure need joint qualification.
entries.next_action: Compare magnetic orientation and acoustic placement compatibility in the same candidate feedstock and verify final orientation and function.
entries.decision: Process precedent; candidate integration study

entries.title: Observation of toroidal pulses of light
entries.possible_insight: Optical and THz toroidal-pulse synthesis supplies structured space-time illumination.
entries.scope_limit: Pulse generation is not gravitational coupling, teleportation or an integrated optical position servo.
entries.next_action: Extract required source, surface response and measured field before selecting a pulse for a material task.
entries.decision: Research source; no integrated hardware capability promoted

entries.title: Single-antenna super-resolution positioning with nonseparable toroidal pulses
entries.possible_insight: Space-time structured microwave pulses provide position-dependent measured signatures.
entries.scope_limit: Microwave positioning results do not specify optical positioning precision or complete control-loop latency.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Single-emitter microwave apparatus and calibrated signature dictionary.
entries.next_action: Compare latency and observability with simpler calibrated sensing on the same task.
entries.decision: Research source; no integrated hardware capability promoted

entries.title: Spatial light modulator via optically addressed metasurface
entries.possible_insight: Programmable optical boundaries demonstrated through visible complex-amplitude holography, focusing and steering.
entries.scope_limit: 756 nm supercell pitch is not workpiece resolution; addressing, power and fabrication remain part of the system.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Patterned optical material and optical addressing structure; qualify the actual material stack, process and optical response.
entries.next_action: Compare a purchased SLM baseline and a programmable metasurface against one exposure/readout task.
entries.decision: Research source; no integrated hardware capability promoted

entries.title: State Tomography of Toroidal Light Pulses
entries.evidence_status: published experimental report (Journal of Optics 2026); reviewed from the 2025 preprint
entries.possible_insight: Collimated few-cycle optical toroidal pulses are generated and their state is measured by tomography; the links between space, time and polarisation are scored by concurrence and fidelity against the ideal pulse.
entries.scope_limit: Projection-based tomography is not automatically real-time machine feedback.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Pulse compression, segmented waveplate and spatial filtering; optical band near 805 nm.
entries.next_action: Budget acquisition and reconstruction latency for the proposed observable.
entries.decision: Research source; no integrated hardware capability promoted

entries.title: Material Science Laboratory Electromagnetic Levitator (MSL-EML)
entries.possible_insight: Coil fields position and heat conductive samples for containerless materials processing.
entries.scope_limit: Microgravity operation has a different force requirement from ground levitation; no anomalous gravitational effect is established.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Conducting sample, coil field, temperature and imaging instrumentation.
entries.next_action: Define target material, net force, thermal history and ground-environment requirements for any derived module.
entries.decision: Research source; no integrated hardware capability promoted

entries.title: Magnetic vortex wormhole generator
entries.possible_insight: Claims include lift/mass effects and crystal joining through a proposed vortex mechanism.
entries.scope_limit: Reviewed patent text does not provide calibrated force or material-property data establishing the proposed effects.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Proposed coil apparatus; source text is not a qualified build specification.
entries.next_action: Extract a quantitative force or material prediction and controls distinguishing ordinary EM/mechanical/thermal responses.
entries.decision: Research source; no integrated hardware capability promoted

entries.title: Water energy generator
entries.possible_insight: Description connects a separately named rotating magnetic vortex generator to material-softening claims.
entries.scope_limit: The separate device identity remains unresolved; the text supplies no calibrated softening measurement.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Claimed apparatus and mechanisms require a material-specific prediction before engineering use.
entries.next_action: Resolve the referenced rotating-vortex source and compare yield/flow changes at matched temperature.
entries.decision: Research source; no integrated hardware capability promoted

entries.title: Full body teleportation system
entries.possible_insight: Related vortex and toroidal-waveguide concepts retained for source traceability.
entries.scope_limit: Patent publication does not establish a working teleporter or validate the proposed gravitational mechanism.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Proposed apparatus; no qualified Replicator component derived.
entries.next_action: Request independently assessable apparatus and outcome records before evaluating a claimed implementation.
entries.decision: Research source; no integrated hardware capability promoted

entries.title: Graviflyer Replication Experiments
entries.possible_insight: A replica combines rotating structures, electric/magnetic excitation and acoustics; report motivates coupled-force and measurement analysis.
entries.scope_limit: This account reports horizontal deflection and RF interference while sustained vertical lift was not achieved; no raw calibrated dataset reviewed.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Apparatus-version and force-sensor details require original records.
entries.next_action: Identify the specific successful replication being cited and obtain force records with electromagnetic, airflow, vibration and cable-force controls.
entries.decision: Research source; no integrated hardware capability promoted

entries.title: A Self-Sensing Piezoelectric Actuator for Collocated Control
entries.possible_insight: Two-terminal reference-capacitor bridge subtracts dielectric slewing current C0 dV/dt across a driven piezoelectric crystal to recover motional strain x(t) and velocity dx/dt simultaneously during actuation without TX/RX switching dead time.
entries.scope_limit: Analog bridge balance drifts as piezo clamped capacitance C0 shifts with temperature (~0.3%/C, -50 dB) and drive level unless tracked digitally; a 2 mm airborne droplet echo (-60 to -80 dB) captures a bare zero-crossing comparator across a 5-tone comb.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Requires differential two-terminal access plus matched reference capacitor (such as the cartridge's uncoupled C0 reference piezo) with a 75 MSa/s 1-bit sigma-delta PIO loop (1 comparator + 2R/1C, OSR = 250 over 150 kHz -> 12-16 ENOB / 74-96 dB dynamic range, multiplier-free XOR + popcount lock-in) or synchronous multi-MSa/s ADCs.
entries.next_action: Simulate 75 MSa/s 1-bit sigma-delta + XOR lock-in under C0 drift and -70 dB echoes, then run bench coupon K-HAPTIC-PZT across the 24-120 kHz harmonic comb.
entries.decision: Primary precedent for simultaneous two-terminal piezo HAPTIC self-sensing

entries.title: Levitation of Iridium and Liquid Mercury by Ultrasound
entries.possible_insight: Single-axis airborne ultrasonic cavity resonance levitates the densest solid and liquid metals (iridium 22.6 g/cm3, mercury 13.6 g/cm3, steel ~7.8 g/cm3) by storing standing-wave energy reactively in the coupled transducer-reflector-sample air cavity.
entries.scope_limit: Single-axis resonant gap driven by a high-power horn source; extending dense-metal holding to 3D multi-tone chord-locking on thin dispersive plates remains open.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Requires automatic frequency/phase tracking of the object-shifted coupled-cavity resonance as air temperature and sphere position vary.
entries.next_action: Model coupled chamber-plus-sphere eigenmode shift and Q_cav holding power P_hold = omega E_stored / Q_cav for a 2-3 mm steel ball in the twin.
entries.decision: Published precedent for airborne high-density resonant holding; coupled-cavity distinction recorded

entries.title: Compressive 3D ultrasound imaging using a single sensor
entries.possible_insight: A single ultrasound transducer fitted with a 3D-printed aberrant plastic coding mask encodes 3D spatial scatterers into distinct broadband echo signatures for single-sensor compressive 3D reconstruction.
entries.scope_limit: Water/phantom imaging precedent using broadband RX pulses and calibrated impulse responses; does not demonstrate multi-trap airborne radiation-force manipulation from a single channel.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: 3D-printed spatially varying plastic delay mask; requires broadband transducer impulse response and spatially varying PSF calibration.
entries.next_action: Extract SNR, bandwidth, mask thickness profile, and dual-sided opposed-mask multiplexing gain for 3+3 simultaneous TX/RX tomography.
entries.decision: Reference precedent for single/few-channel coded sensing; no architecture adoption

entries.title: Deep Learning-Based Framework for Fast and Accurate Acoustic Hologram Generation
entries.possible_insight: Unsupervised physics-guided autoencoder (HU-Net) pairs a U-Net encoder with an Angular Spectrum Method physical constraint decoder to generate 3D-printed lens and 2D array acoustic holograms significantly faster than iterative angular spectrum or Diff-PAT solvers.
entries.scope_limit: Free-space monochromatic Angular Spectrum physics layer does not model closed high-Q chamber multipath, multi-tone quadratic Gor'kov force superposition, or sparse 3+3 transducer excitation; repository license requires verification before code reuse.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Targets 3D-printed phase plates and dense 2D ultrasound arrays; evaluated only as a neural warm-start for a measured closed-cavity H(f_n) + Gor'kov optimizer.
entries.next_action: Verify repository license on github.com/Moon-Hwan/HUnet and benchmark swapping the ASM decoder for a measured closed-cavity H(f_n) + Gor'kov loss.
entries.decision: Candidate solver acceleration (neural warm-start); no architecture adoption

entries.title: Deep learning-based super-resolution acoustic holography for phased transducer array
entries.evidence_status: published simulation and water-tank experimental report
entries.possible_insight: Physics-integrated U-Net/GAN (SRAH) embeds linear acoustic wave propagation inside training to drive a lower-SBP phased transducer array toward the acoustic wave diffraction limit.
entries.scope_limit: Tested on a 50 x 50 (2,500-element) PZT-5A matrix at 2.32 MHz in water (800 um elements, 1 mm pitch); overcomes coarse array pitch aliasing up to the classical wave diffraction limit, does not surpass half-wavelength diffraction or demonstrate 3+3 airborne ports.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Water-coupled 2.32 MHz PZT-5A array; requires adaptation to airborne broadband multi-tone forcing and measured closed-cavity Green's functions.
entries.next_action: Obtain full methods and test whether an SRAH-style physics-constrained generator can co-optimize sparse 3+3 multi-tone drives plus passive scatterer geometry against sidelobe bounds.
entries.decision: Candidate solver and aperture co-design reference; no architecture adoption

entries.title: Imaging of acoustic fields using optical feedback interferometry
entries.possible_insight: Self-mixing / optical feedback interferometry (OFI) inside a laser diode cavity measures airborne ultrasonic pressure fields via acousto-optic refractive-index modulation without external photodiodes, beam splitters, or Mach-Zehnder reference arms.
entries.scope_limit: Published OFI ultrasound imaging uses analog amplification; weak air-path fringes (~50 uV - 1 mV per 2pi fringe, P031) cannot trigger 200 mV Schmitt MCU GPIOs directly, and opaque objects still block line-of-sight rays.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Standard 3-pin laser diode using built-in monitor photodiode (or AC-coupled anode) + 1 SOT-23 op-amp (~200x AC gain) + 1-bit sigma-delta comparator into RP2350B PIO, XIN/SYNC phase-locked to the acoustic comb.
entries.next_action: Simulate 0.1 rad LightRead phase recovery in the 1-bit sigma-delta front-end and run bench coupon K-MOSQUITO-SMI for simultaneous DC bead occlusion and 40 kHz ultrasonic phase SNR.
entries.decision: Primary precedent for beam-splitter-free self-mixing optical wave/matter readout

entries.title: Laser diode self-mixing technique for sensing applications
entries.possible_insight: Establishes quantitative laser-diode self-mixing interferometry (SMI) equations and signal amplitudes (~50 uV to ~1 mV per 2pi fringe across weak/moderate feedback) via built-in rear monitor photodiode or junction terminal voltage.
entries.scope_limit: Microvolt-to-millivolt air-path fringe voltages shift digital Schmitt timing by ~0.1 ps versus 6.67 ns PIO ticks, requiring an AC gain stage (~200x) before 1-bit sigma-delta quantization.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: 3-pin TO-can laser diode + SOT-23 AC op-amp + 2R/1C comparator feeding 75 MSa/s 1-bit sigma-delta PIO.
entries.next_action: Size AC-gain and sigma-delta comparator thresholds for bench coupon K-MOSQUITO-SMI.
entries.decision: Quantitative device-physics reference sizing the SMI optical front-end

entries.title: Equilibrium Propagation: Bridging the Gap between Energy-Based Models and Backpropagation
entries.possible_insight: Computes exact energy-based recurrent network gradients from two physical settles (free and weakly nudged) and local contrastive outer products without a backpropagation activation tape, enabling < 60 kB 5-10% sparse complex Hermitian SRAM adaptation on RP2350B (~8-15 ms settle) and reciprocal optical plasticity via Helmholtz symmetry.
entries.scope_limit: Exact gradient guarantee requires symmetric/Hermitian reciprocal coupling and contractive fixed-point settling; physical optical/PCM endurance, 4-6 bit quantization, and thermal phase drift remain unmeasured on our bench.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Tied Hermitian weights (||W||_2 <= 1) quantized to 5-10% sparse int8 (< 60 kB) on RP2350B SRAM or FPGA dual-port BRAM now; reciprocal Sb2S3/Sb2Se3 PCM + threshold laser-diode somas as future hardware.
entries.next_action: Benchmark 5-10% sparse complex Hermitian wave-somas across ideal_fp32, rp2350_ganglia_q8, fpga_int8_sparse, and optical_pcm_analog simulation tiers.
entries.decision: Foundational learning-rule precedent for sparse SRAM adaptation and reciprocal optical plasticity

entries.title: Time-Reversed Lasing and Interferometric Control of Absorption
entries.evidence_status: published experimental report; only the one-sentence indexed summary was read
entries.possible_insight: Experimental companion to R068. Science 331(6019), 889-892. The indexed summary states that tuning the amplitude and phase of incident light can enhance the optical absorption process, i.e. absorption is controlled interferometrically by the input fields.
entries.scope_limit: Optical experiment; sample, wavelength, achieved absorption contrast and bandwidth were NOT read this session and are not recorded. Not an acoustic or airborne demonstration; does not establish CPA in this machine's chamber.
entries.next_action: Read the full text for the measured absorption modulation depth and the phase/amplitude tolerance before quoting any number.
entries.decision: experimental precedent for optical CPA; details unread; no architecture adoption

entries.title: Nonradiating anapole modes in dielectric nanoparticles
entries.possible_insight: Experimental demonstration that dielectric nanoparticles support a radiationless anapole mode in the visible: electric and toroidal dipole moments with similar far-field patterns interfere destructively, giving a pronounced dip in far-field scattering together with a characteristic near-field distribution; spectral overlap of the two modes is reached by tuning geometry. Nature Communications 6, 8069.
entries.scope_limit: Electromagnetic (optical) scattering from dielectric nanoparticles. Not acoustic, not a driven macroscopic chamber, and not evidence that an anapole-like excitation deposits energy or does mechanical work in a workpiece. Particle material and dimensions were not read (abstract only).
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Abstract states only that mode overlap is achieved 'through a geometry tuning'; dimensions and tolerances not read.
entries.next_action: If INS-13 needs a non-radiating source configuration, state the acoustic or EM analogue explicitly and model its far-field cancellation in the twin; do not cite this paper for anything beyond optical anapole existence.
entries.decision: optical precedent for non-radiating anapole modes; no architecture adoption
